_doc: Project config for the SA-02m web interface (Armbian ARM device: nginx + fcgiwrap + Bash CGI + vanilla JS frontend, no build step). Value-home for mode/profile/kind/docLanguage/collaboration. Fields absent or unrecognised fall back to the safe defaults documented in PROTOCOL.md `## Project config`. Re-run /dev-setup any time to reconfigure via dialog; the file itself is authoritative.
_project_rules: Our project-specific rulesets (web-code-rigor, web-workflow, sa02m-domain, git-commits, web-diagnostic-tools, agent-tooling-map) are NOT capability modules — the ai-dev module registry lives inside .ai-dev/tooling/ (invariant 2, unconditional off-limits). The rulesets live in docs/agent-rules/*.md as project canon and are @-imported by CLAUDE.md; every orchestrator session loads them. Adapted from the MR-02m firmware project's ruleset (same protocol, web domain).
